matrix.source_statement: Create the required raw intake, requirement register, Product Quality Compiler packet, state matrix, execution run, screenshots/audit evidence, deployment verification, and do not stop after planning documents.

Operations must show unmistakable Super Admin, actual Rabbi, and read-only view-as identity states; signed view-as must force workspace/project scope, deny conflicting scope, project /api/bna/auth/me as Rabbi owner identity, and block writes without broadening reads.

One Time CRM must show only explicitly owned One Time records; missing ownership fails closed, ambiguous records are quarantined, cross-workspace email matches are insufficient, and enrichment for mailbox, support, tasks, membership, communications, and timeline must apply workspace/project restrictions.

Customer-facing UI must not display internal storage names such as bna_contacts or bna_parent_leads; use human-facing One Time source labels and produce a redacted dry-run production scope report over the approximately 503 visible records without exposing private contact information.

Replace CRM fetch-all/filter-in-JavaScript architecture with database-side scoped search, filters, sort, cursor pagination, list/detail endpoints, facets/summary, indexes, EXPLAIN proof, and representative 10,000-contact fixture performance.

CRM frontend must avoid the giant global data loader/root rerender on contact selection, use AbortController, debounced search, cached detail, scoped refresh, hidden legacy table avoidance, and retire duplicate legacy renderer after parity.

Build a professional first-party One Time CRM with desktop three-pane list/conversation/profile, mobile list-to-detail flow, tabs, notes, tasks, profile fields, valid Rabbi updates, and read-only view-as disabled writes.

Create a scoped One Time Inbox with thread list, active conversation, contact context, filters, One Time-only workspace behavior, selected-contact retention, replies updating timeline, internal-note separation, and provider/channel audit metadata.

Normalize portal information architecture: /rabbi-member user-facing Family Portal, /student Student Portal, /one-time-classroom shared Classroom, /member-library Library, and /one-time-parent account setup/reset, with clear preview action labels.

Create a shared One Time portal shell across Family, Student, Classroom, Library, parent setup/reset, and preview modes with same logo, tokens, fonts, header, navigation, buttons, focus styles, footer, and role-appropriate links.

Replace the CSS pseudo-element hamburger with one real focusable/clickable accessible button supporting aria-controls, aria-expanded, Escape/backdrop close, focus trap, focus return, and responsive behavior.

Preview mode must show TEST PREVIEW / SAMPLE DATA / NO WRITES, preserve review mode across Family/Student/Classroom/Library, provide Exit Preview, enforce support boundaries, and use safe TEST synthetic student fixtures that never enter production CRM, reminders, sends, or metrics.

Preserve latest deployed landing design but remove Robot Scheller character and public quick-command widget/scripts, replacing them with an accessible standard WhatsApp wa.me launcher using ONE_TIME_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER without hardcoded credentials.

Make the One Time WhatsApp assistant natural using the existing provider-bot profile and buildProviderLeadBotSystemPrompt while preserving deterministic security decisions, scoped retrieval, response validation, fallback behavior, and multi-turn tests.

Meet performance budgets, split Operations bundles, minify/fingerprint assets, enable compression/caching, add required behavioral tests, capture screenshots, commit/push/merge/deploy both services, verify exact SHA, and run live smokes before Done.
